module: State node "State Node" of the stategraph (created by _flowgraph_createStateNode). Represents a target graph (targetGraph) in the state graph; pins: flow (input), success and fail (outputs of type state), plus custom outputs (transitions). Can export its state to a .state.flow.json file. Double-click: opens the target graph.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

representsGraph.desc: Returns the target graph represented by this node.

setTargetGraph.desc: Associates a target graph, takes its name and takes the "groupstate" color if it is a state graph; otherwise name "No Target!".

drawCustomProperties.desc: "Target Graph" dropdown (root graphs outside the state graph) and "Export State" button (JSON save via editor_fileDialog).

getTransitionNames.desc: Returns the sorted list of output pin names (possible transitions).

doubleClicked.desc: Selects the target graph in the editor.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the editor.

_postDeserialize.desc: After all graphs are loaded, finds the target graph (id + getGraphNodeOffset offset) and associates it.

onCustomNameChanged.desc: Renames the target graph and returns a history message.

_onSerializeState.desc: Serializes the node + target graph for the state export (res.type = 'state').
